privacy_data:aalto-privacy-approved-grou.summaryZh: 作业仅限提交至校方审核通过的版权与隐私系统
privacy_data:aalto-privacy-approved-grou.scope: Teacher coursework submission in approved systems

evidence.quote: The teacher may only submit student work or require students themselves to submit student work in systems approved by Aalto University, among other things, for copyright and privacy reasons.

approved_tools:aalto-tools-directory-gro.text: Aalto provides a directory of official AI services.
approved_tools:aalto-tools-directory-gro.summaryZh: 官方服务门户集中提供Aalto AI Assistant及Copilot

evidence.quote: The official AI services provided by Aalto University can be found at https://www.aalto.fi/en/services/ai-services.

research_publication:aalto-research-auth.text: Students are responsible for submitted work; language models can help with formatting or ideation unless the teacher instructs otherwise, but AI-generated text cannot be presented as is as the student’s own written response.
research_publication:aalto-research-auth.summaryZh: 学生承担完全责任严禁将AI原始文本充作己作

evidence.quote: The student is always responsible for the content of their submitted work. For example, language models can be used for formatting or ideation of the text produced, unless otherwise instructed by the teacher. However, AI-generated text cannot be presented as is as the student's own written response.

academic_integrity:aalto-integrity-cheat.text: Utilising AI in a learning task contrary to the teacher's instructions is considered cheating and handled in accordance with the current procedures.
academic_integrity:aalto-integrity-cheat.summaryZh: 违背教师明确限制擅用AI定性为作弊移交处分
academic_integrity:aalto-integrity-cheat.scope: AI cheating definition and handling under current procedures

evidence.quote: Utilising AI in a learning task contrary to the teacher's instructions will be considered cheating and will be handled in accordance with the current procedures.

teaching_guidance:aalto-teaching-timing-.text: Teachers deciding to restrict AI must provide clear instructions in assessment criteria and time guidance so students can complete tasks properly.
teaching_guidance:aalto-teaching-timing-.summaryZh: 教师设限须在考核标准中写明并及时发布通知
teaching_guidance:aalto-teaching-timing-.scope: Assessment design and instructor guidance timing

evidence.quote: If the teacher decides to restrict the use of AI on a course- or task-specific basis, they must provide clear instructions on the limitations in connection with the assessment criteria and time the guidance so that the student has the possibility to complete the task as instructed.

security_procurement:aalto-procurement-v.text: Teachers cannot require students to create accounts in unvetted systems or purchase software licenses, ensuring equality and security.
security_procurement:aalto-procurement-v.summaryZh: 严禁强迫学生注册未审核外部账号或自费购买软件
security_procurement:aalto-procurement-v.scope: Security check and financial equity requirements

evidence.quote: The teacher cannot require the student to create an account in systems that have not been subjected to Aalto University's security check. When designing their course, the teacher must ensure that students are not put in an unequal position. This implies that the teacher cannot require the student to purchase licenses for systems.
evidence.location: Student equality and security check requirement
